owner_schema_ruling: M321965/M321966 approve authority schema 6; resolved, not reopened
p1_race_fixed: every component is OPENED relative to the previous component's descriptor with O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW, so the path is never re-resolved by name and check and use are the same act
the final component opens relative to its parent's descriptor with O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK; O_NONBLOCK so a FIFO cannot block the check, and fstat refuses anything but a regular file
a symlink at ANY depth, including the root itself, is named escapes-root (Linux answers ENOTDIR for O_DIRECTORY on a dirlink, so the naming lstat runs only after the open has already refused)
p1_retained_fixed: RETAINED is a closed required inventory in both _manifest and _check; required_retained is declared and compared
an omitted retained field, an absent configured root or an unreadable tree is a fault, not proof that nothing was retained
only a root the instance contract does not name is legitimate absence (not-configured)
os.walk now has an onerror handler, so a silently skipped unreadable subtree makes the walk incomplete instead of smaller
directory symlinks are recorded: they appear in dirnames, never filenames, so the previous walk bound none of them despite its comment
readonly_boundary_fixed: Authority.stored_identity added as the supported public read-only observation: the authority's own probe, the one open() itself uses, exposed because open() REFUSES an incompatible store and so cannot answer which version it is
_stored_identity no longer runs raw SQL and probes a COPY of the store and its sidecars, leaving the restored set untouched
unchanged_after_observation RE-READS every store and its sidecars after the probe, so byte identity is measured rather than asserted, on success and on refusal
